description: This file defines the 'Merge' class for constructing and executing SQL MERGE operations within Drupal's database abstraction layer. It includes methods for setting table, fields, conditions, and executing the merge logic, handling insert/update scenarios.

classes.name: Merge
classes.description: Represents a SQL MERGE query, allowing configuration of insert/update fields, conditions, and execution logic within Drupal's database layer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Merge object with database connection, target table, and options.

methods.name: conditionTable
methods.description: Sets the table or subquery used for the merge condition.

methods.name: updateFields
methods.description: Sets fields and values for the update part of the merge.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Defines a field to be updated with an expression, such as counters.

methods.name: insertFields
methods.description: Sets fields and values for the insert part of the merge.

methods.name: useDefaults
methods.description: Specifies fields to use database defaults on insert.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Sets common fields and values for both insert and update.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Sets key fields for the merge condition and insert.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Sets a single key field for the merge condition.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Throws exception; merge query cannot be converted to string.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the merge operation, inserting or updating as needed, and returns status.
